prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: unit-b-pixel, ONE sprite in a five-asset dark-fantasy style study; targeted clean 64x64 pixel-art simplification.
Input images: Image 1 is our original unit A. Use ONLY its identity, gear, right-facing stance and approximately 30-degree three-quarter top-down view. Discard all painterly texture and fine detail.
Primary request: A genuinely hand-designed low-resolution pixel sprite on exactly a 64 by 64 logical pixel grid, enlarged 8x with nearest-neighbor to 512x512. Clearly large square pixel blocks, each block occupies 1/64 of the image width. One full-body weary sellsword, same short grey-streaked dark hair and stubble, brown padded gambeson, sword pointing down-right in right hand, plain round shield and steel boss on left forearm, belt, boots. Face, chest and stance face right. Both feet and entire sword remain visible.
Style/medium: Crisp intentional low-resolution pixel-art cluster design, NOT a pixelated photograph or downsampled painting. Strong ONE-LOGICAL-PIXEL dark outline. Broad compact clusters, simplified anatomy and readable iconic equipment, restrained proportions. Use a maximum of 16 solid subject colors; two or three colors per material. The head is about 8x9 logical pixels, face about 4x5; shield about 13x19; complete unit about 53 logical pixels tall with sword. A few deliberate diagonal seam pixels suggest the padded gambeson; no tiny quilt texture, noisy texture, fine hair or photographic highlights. Flat solid pixel colors, no gradients, dithering, antialiasing or blur. Make skin and steel easily distinguishable from muted dark-brown clothing. Preserve the weary rather than cute mood.
Composition/framing: Centered square 64x64 logical canvas, generous clear margin, full isolated body, three-quarter top-down orthographic camera pitched down about 30 degrees; sword, shield, boots and hair entirely inside the frame. Single sprite only; no grid lines or multiple views.
Scene/backdrop: Uniform #00ff00 chroma-key background for local transparent-alpha removal, or isolated transparent alpha if supported. No shadows, floor, checkerboard or scenery; no green anywhere in unit.
Constraints: This is the SAME original sellsword as unit A, with drastic intentional pixel-medium simplification. Do not imitate Battle Brothers, Heroes of Might and Magic, any other game, franchise or artist. No text, logos, labels, watermarks or signatures. Produce exactly one image.
